title: 2 Euro Cents

obverse.description: A young, feminine Marianne with determined features that embody the desire for a sound and lasting Europe. Around twelve five-pointed stars representing the European Union.

reverse.description: A globe, next to the face value, shows Europe in relation to Africa and Asia.
